CustomField.description: Number of days the Analytics Dashboard looks back when querying Routing_Log__c. Controls the LAST_N_DAYS filter on all three lenses (velocity, SLA compliance, agent utilisation). Higher values increase query scope and response time. Recommended range: 7–90. Default: 30.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How many days of routing history to show on the Analytics Dashboard. Default: 30.
CustomField.label: Default Lookback Days
